title: n8n Relocation Plan
user: n8n maintainers moving exported workflows between environments
problem: Credential IDs and called-workflow IDs are environment-specific. Bulk replacement can bind a node to an ambiguous or incompatible target.
capability: Create a typed reference-mapping plan, report ambiguous/dynamic references and apply a reviewed plan only when both the workflow and catalog still match.
pin: Export metadata shape reviewed at n8n commit9a489b65ed539a042e819012558cfc6985aab78d, interfaces.ts blob e31059c38296d46c7d0361378d61a0dc99644d5f; current release observed n8n@2.44.6. File-format tests only; live server imports are untested.
query: topic:workflow-automation stars:>10000 archived:false sort:stars; n8n migration sort:stars; n8n backup sort:stars
demand: Issue20049 records historical credential-import pain and is closed. Existing n8n-porter already supports environment mapping. This tool targets a narrower offline reviewed-plan workflow; demand for it is inferred, not an upstream feature request.
addition: n8n supplies export/import; n8n Backup Manager backs up/restores instances and snapshots; n8n-porter migrates resources with server configuration and credential payloads. This tool requires neither server/API access nor credential data and binds a reviewable plan to the exact input documents. No claim that the other tools lack all equivalent safeguards.
outcome: The invented example maps one typed credential reference and one literal child-workflow ID. Applying the exact reviewed plan writes a new inactive workflow export and leaves other node parameters/connections intact.
acceptance: Exact type/name or explicit typed mappings produce deterministic target references.
Ambiguous names, wrong types and dynamic child IDs stay unresolved and block application.
Changing an input or tampering with plan operations rejects application.
Credential payload fields and duplicate node IDs reject.
fields: Input is one object with `workflow` (one n8n export) and `catalog`. Catalog credentials contain only id/name/type metadata; workflows maps source IDs to target IDs. Optional explicit_credentials keys have TYPE:SOURCE_ID form. Export credential references support assigned string id/name only. Null IDs and AI Gateway managed slots reject.
limits: 4 MiB JSON, up to2000 nodes and5000 credential metadata records. Literal executeWorkflow workflowId references only; expressions remain unresolved. Does not resolve arbitrary node parameters, URLs, environment variables, custom/community-node references, access rights or encryption. No n8n server execution/import, credential decryption, copying, activation or API calls. Relocated output is always active:false and cannot overwrite an existing file. Exports and reports can contain sensitive names/parameters; keep real files private.
distinction: Existing generic JSON diff tools and agent-sbom do not perform typed n8n reference relocation with stale-plan rejection. This is one complete file-transformation workflow, not a general migration platform.
maintenance: No runtime dependencies. Recheck export shape and newly managed credential slots against pinned upstream types before broadening support. n8n is fair-code/Sustainable Use licensed with enterprise exclusions, not a permissively licensed dependency. No n8n source, branding or code is bundled; the original interoperable tool is MIT.
discovery: An offline relocation example, ambiguous-name failure case and accurate n8n export/import topics and portfolio index entry.
demand_status: Inferred demand for this specific project; linked upstream evidence is qualified below.
